maintenance_contract.atomic_unit: one Host retirement, complete Object cleanup or metadata entry
maintenance_contract.complete: queues/retirements empty and scan observed current mutation epoch; not all capacity free or global/native completion
order: retired Host roots by lease ID
maintenance_contract.scan: persistent per-origin cursor, fixed pass high-watermark, mutation epoch; dirty completed pass requires another pass; u64 epoch wrap sets allocation-free force-rescan flag
maintenance_contract.scope_authority: store/VM only; never HostScope or HostValue

policies.quota_return: after record/metadata removal, not semantic retirement
policies.resource_scope: semantic counts, not process memory bytes or wall-clock budget
policies.terminal_close: retain arena for Host roots; structural final teardown
policies.zero_exec_remove: preflight and synchronous variable cleanup; freed record awaits reap

max_exec_refs_per_object.charge: installed and prospective Object execution leases

max_function_heads.charge: registered Function metadata plus prospective head reservations; retired entries remain charged until removal

max_objects.charge: resident lifecycle records plus prospective object reservations; includes queued, shell and freed-unreaped

max_ordinary_refs_per_object.charge: Object payload, creator and queue owners, including provisional owners

max_owners_per_header.charge: Function/Array/Mapping semantic owners, including provisional and transport owners
